_note: AI-drafted Call to Worship — pending Wilson's curation.

registers.label: Spare
lines: The shepherds heard and could not stay.
Let us go now and see this thing.
They found the child just as the angel said.
And they came back glorifying God.
Light dawns for the righteous this night.
Glory to God in the highest!
Come, let us go and see; come, let us worship.
Glory to God in the highest! Amen.

registers.label: Immersive
lines: The shepherds left their flocks in the dark and hurried — over the fields, into the town, straight to the manger where the child lay.
Glory to God in the highest!
They told what they had heard, and Mary kept it all, turning each word over quietly in her heart.
Glory to God in the highest!
Then back they went to the hills, no longer afraid, glorifying and praising God for all they had seen.
Glory to God in the highest!
So we come running too, to kneel and to look, and we will not go home in silence.
Glory to God in the highest, and peace on earth! Amen.

registers.label: Hybrid
lines: The shepherds hurry to the manger in the dark.
Glory to God in the highest!
They find the child, just as they were told.
Glory to God in the highest!
They return to the hills, praising God aloud.
Glory to God in the highest!
Come, let us go and see, and worship him.
Glory to God in the highest! Amen.
